payload.title: Loading data into Pyleoclim
payload.description: This notebook demonstrates how to load various data formats into the Pyleoclim library for paleoclimate analysis. It covers importing data from pre-loaded datasets, LiPD files, NetCDF files, CSV files, NOAA text files, and PANGAEA datasets. The notebook utilizes several Python libraries to handle different data formats and convert them into Pyleoclim Series objects, which are essential for time series analysis in paleoclimatology.
